# hestiacp_mail_domain_catchall (Resource)

Sets a catch-all email address for a HestiaCP mail domain.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Mail domain to configure.
- `email` (String) Catch-all destination email address.

### Optional

- `user` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
